title: Thai Beef Salad
description: In this tasty Thai beef salad recipe, seared steak is marinated in a spicy mixture of Thai flavors and served on a crisp lettuce and cucumber salad.
ingredients: 1 cup chopped fresh cilantro, plus more for garnish
1 stalk lemongrass, smashed and cut into 1-inch pieces
1 head leaf lettuce - rinsed, dried and torn into bite-size pieces

steps.text: Mix lime juice, cilantro, mint leaves, sugar, fish sauce, green onions, lemongrass, and chili sauce together in a large bowl until sugar is dissolved. Adjust the flavor, if desired, by adding more sugar and/or fish sauce; set aside.
Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate.

Cook steak on the preheated grill until it begins to firm and is hot and slightly pink in the center, about 4 to 6 minutes per side. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read 140 degrees F (60 degrees C).
Transfer steak to a chopping board and slice into thin strips; add steak and its juices into the bowl with herb mixture. Cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
Place lettuce in a salad bowl; arrange cucumber on top. Add steak and pour all of the herb mixture on top. Scatter cherry tomatoes over salad and garnish with fresh cilantro leaves.

video.description: Keep it light but satisfying with this flavorful Thai salad. Turn up the flavor by mixing together green onion with lemongrass, cilantro, mint, lime juice, fish sauce, chili sauce and sugar. After you’ve grilled a 1 ½ lb steak medium, cut into thin strips and marinate in the sauce for at least 3 hours. Make your salad base with green leaf lettuce and diced English cucumber. When you’re ready to eat, pour on the sauce and beef, and garnish with cilantro and cherry tomatoes for a salad both fresh and filling.
